name: Agentic Travel Backend
description: The core travel-planning backend for conversations, structured plans, reports, RAG, and tool collaboration.

name: Travel Agent
description: Turns travel requirements into destinations, itinerary days, budget, transportation, accommodation, risks, and alternatives.

name: Structured Plan
description: A frontend-ready structured travel plan model for cards, reports, and fallback demos.

name: Skills System
description: Loads travel-domain skills from classpath Markdown and injects selected guidance into the agent flow.

name: RAG Memory
description: Uses travel knowledge retrieval to make answers more grounded and explainable.

name: Tool Agent
description: Extends agent behavior with search, files, terminal, downloads, and content-processing tools.

name: Guarded Tools
description: Adds validation and boundaries around tool calls to reduce unsafe input or unauthorized execution.

name: Eval Harness
description: Scores travel-agent output against configurable cases and quality dimensions for regression protection.

name: Agent Trace
description: Records key steps from intent detection through skill loading, planning, budget, risk checks, and reporting.

name: Wayfinder Portfolio Backend
description: Provides map, NPC, project, skill, module, and profile metadata for Wayfinder Guild.
